spanish: Habla a hijos de Israel: Varón o mujer, cuando hagan desde todos pecados del adam a perpetrar perpetración en Jehová, y culpada es el alma aquella,

findings.issue: הָאָדָם is a common noun with the article (H120), not a proper name; "adam" leaves that noun untranslated.
לִמְעֹל מַעַל is the cognate infinitive and noun of an unfaithful act (H4603, H4604). "perpetrar perpetración" keeps the doubling but substitutes generic perpetration and drops the unfaithfulness.
כִּי is marked only as a conjunction; "cuando" selects a temporal sense and closes if, because, and that.
מִן in מִכָּל means from or of before כָּל; "desde" reads as a starting point.
Qal perfect 3fs is stative be or become guilty; "culpada" can be read as a passive participle, accused.

notes: 3mp יַעֲשׂוּ and 3fs וְאָשְׁמָה match the Spanish; יהוה is Jehová.
